spec_features.feature_name: loop ends on no-tools / submit / turn cap
spec_features.spec_quote: The loop ends when the model (a) stops requesting tools, (b) calls `submit`, or (c) hits the turn cap
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `if not turn.tool_calls: result.finished_naturally = True; break` (a); `if executor.submitted: ... break` (b); `if result.num_turns >= max_turns: result.hit_turn_cap = True; break` (c). All three break the while True loop.
spec_features.notes: All three termination conditions are wired and stop execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: RunResult so a single failure never aborts the whole experiment. (loop docstring describes mechanics only, no welfare rationale)

Tool is dispatched in the handler map and honored as a stop.
